description: Aggregated experiment view: experiment overview + topN runs (sorted by metric or start_time) + metric stats (min/max/mean across topN) in a single call. Replaces 3-5 round-trips of get-experiment + search-runs + get-best-run.

ascending.description: 'true' or 'false' (default 'false'). Only meaningful when metric is set.

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response. Use `*` as wildcard.

metric.description: Metric key to sort topN by; if omitted, sorts by start_time DESC

topN.description: Number of top runs to return (default 5, max 20)

name: summarize-experiment
